title: ze_silent_hill_3_flee
description:
地图名：《寂静岭3：逃离》
地图作者：港村村长
版本：V4
该地图全译名为《寂静岭3：逃离》，与原游戏三代剧情没有关系，属于CSGO僵尸逃跑社区服务器里的一个地图系列。故事延续《寂静岭3：黎明》地图里的幸存者，逃到地面上后回到表世界并继续寻找出路，寻找收集末点亮的印记，最终回到现实世界。
=--------------------------------------------=
MAP;ze_silent_hill_3_flee
MAP by 港村村长
Version: V4
The full translation of this map is "Silent Hill 3: Escape", which has nothing to do with the storyline of the original game's third generation and belongs to a map series in the CSGO Zombie Escape Community server. The story continues with the survivors in the map of Silent Hill 3: Dawn, who flee to the surface and return to the surface world to continue searching for a way out, collecting the imprint of the Last Light, and ultimately returning to the real world.
